Personal Statement
I am an innovative Data Analyst with over 5 years of experience in analytics, specializing in agile methodologies and
fast-paced environments. I am proficient in SQL, Excel, Power BI, DAX, Python and R, I deliver data-driven insights and
translate complex data into actionable business strategies. My strong communication and collaborative skills ensure
effective teamwork and stakeholder engagement. I have a proven track record in product development and process
optimization, driving business growth while maintaining regulatory compliance. I hold a First Class Honours in
Mathematics and Economics, with Distinctions in Industrial Mathematics and Data Science.
